title: Assembly of the ordinary balanced scalar tower comparison
statement: Fix ordinary quotient model M, coefficient scalar systems A, normalized finite scalar evaluations rho, and finite balanced associations. The degreewise composite of rho, scalar extension of M.evaluation, and association gives a natural isomorphism from M.quotient followed by ordinary sequence scalar extension and completed-coefficient restriction to the direct scalar tower, on every cochain complex. Its hom at level n is the restricted-complex evaluation comparison followed by coefficient restriction of this explicit degreewise finite composite. The notation is that of [def-trf-completion-unit-models], [stage3-pur-scalar-cochain-evaluation], [stage3-pur-finite-extension-association], [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension], [def-trf-ordinary-quotient-scalar-tower-levels].

source.place: 03D7, ordinary scalar-extension adjunction; 03EK, tensor products. Fully proved ordinary substep of the strict scalar quotient comparison.

proof.text: Form the finite module isomorphisms by composing scalar evaluation, M.evaluation after finite scalar extension, and balanced association. Apply them degreewise; naturality gives chain maps and naturality in complexes.

Use the existing all-complex successor theorem to prove adjacent-transition compatibility after the evaluation and restriction casts. Apply the generic proved assembleTowerIso helper to construct the whole tower natural isomorphism and retain its explicit component equation.

proof_origin.place: Ordinary balanced tensor and adjunction-unit naturality; fully proved private implementation helper, not a new sorry obligation.

theorem comparison_exists
    (A : CoefficientExtensionSystems l E L ι W)
    (M : CompletionUnit.OrdinaryModel l E W)
    (ρ : ∀ n : ℕ, A.scalar.model.E ⋙ coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L W n ≅
      coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n ⋙ (A.levels n).model.E)
    (hρ : IsCoefficientScalarEvaluationUnit l E L ι W A ρ)
    (association : ∀ n : ℕ,
      scalarReductionExtension l E W n ⋙ (A.levels n).model.E ≅
        integralScalarReduction l E L ι W n)
    (hassociation : IsCoefficientExtensionAssociation l E L ι W A association)
    :
    let direct := direct l E L ι W A M
    let directEvaluation := directEvaluation l E L ι W A M ρ association
    ∃ e : direct ⋙ (coefficientSequenceRestriction l L W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
        HomologicalComplex.complexOfFunctorsToFunctorToComplex ≅
      integralScalarTowerFunctor l E L ι W,
      ∀ (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E W) ℤ) (n : ℕ),
        (e.hom.app P).app (op n) =
          (coefficientRestrictedComplexEvaluation l L W n).hom.app (direct.obj P) ≫
            ((scalarReductionRestriction l L W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
              ((directEvaluation n).hom.app P)
